classification_reason: All 20 canon probes answered with ranked, reasoned candidates and no canonical writes. But the product surfaced only 85 of the 158 candidates (54%). `related NOTE` never returns notes, so notes came only via concept/source hops. The two concept-less probe notes (C03, C09) got no note neighbours from the graph. Every garden, inbox and stage target (23 of 158) needed direct file reads because no read command exposes them (F-s06-connections-b-01). Cross-domain links were found only by guessing content-search terms.

consumer.goal: For each canon probe note C01–C20, show the learner what else she has that she should read next to it, best first, with reasons.

confusions: `related` on a note returns only concepts, sources and (sometimes) workspaces, never notes. It took a probe to see that notes are reached via `related CONCEPT` / `related SOURCE`.
OPERATOR.md says the domain atlas can be opened for the full map, but gives no command; `bootstrap --brief` shows only per-domain counts.
bootstrap/status count 7 inbox items and 9 garden entries, but no read command lists or reads them; the connection-probes target vocabulary (garden:, inbox:, stage:) has no product-side counterpart.

`related note-naive-bayes-spam-filter` omits workspace-statlearn-retake although that workspace lists the note, while `related note-cfs-fair-share` does return workspace-os-oral-prep (the note carries `contexts`). Workspace membership is visible from one side only.

Content search splits the query into whitespace tokens and returns every note whose full file (frontmatter included) contains all tokens as case-insensitive substrings, not the phrase. 'System R' returned 11 notes containing 'system' plus any 'r'; none of them mentions System R. 'the log' returned 23 notes (e.g. 'the' + 'topological'). 'MAP' matched 'map'/'maps'. Snippets are listed once per matching token, so 'conditional independence' showed line 2 twice.
corrective_steps: Ran `make setup` after the missing-dependency error (the error named the fix).
Built a two-hop neighbourhood (note → concept/source → notes; concept → atlas relations) because `related` has no note→note edge.
Listed and read garden, inbox and stage working-note files directly after every product read refused them.
consumer.outcome: The learner gets a ranked list of 5–10 items for each of her 20 notes, each with a one-line reason (connections.jsonl, phase canon). Graph-adjacent same-course notes came from the product. The most useful cross-course links came from reading: the independence assumption shared by Naive Bayes and selectivity estimation; Amdahl's law for the 16-worker job; matrix factorisation answering the low-rank note's open question; garden seeds that ask the probe's own question. Where a candidate is weak it is flagged tentative, and contrasts and superseded versions are flagged.

friction.description: AGENTS.md and OPERATOR.md start with `python tools/los.py capabilities`, which fails on a fresh checkout until `make setup` is run. The error names the fix, so recovery was quick.

`related NOTE` has no note→note edges; related notes are reachable only via concept or source hops. Source hops are very broad (source-tuh-statlearn-slides → 21 notes). Probe notes without concepts (C03 parallel workers, C09 data lineage) get no note neighbours from the product at all.
friction.cost: ~100 extra CLI calls in a harvest script

friction.description: Garden seeds, inbox captures and stage working notes are counted by bootstrap/status but are invisible to search, search --content, inspect, related and note-read; plan-edit-context --stage-id returns only the working-note path. 23 of 158 recommended targets had to come from reading canonical Markdown directly, which OPERATOR.md tells interfaces not to do.

There is no similarity or semantic neighbour search. Cross-course connections (a shared independence assumption, Amdahl's law, fairness across scheduling, GPUs and study time) surface only if the operator guesses the exact substring. Concept relations are sparse (28 in total), and atlas-context added nothing beyond direct concept links.
friction.cost: 130 content searches plus reading all 116 note bodies

friction.description: Search precision: content search ANDs whitespace tokens as substrings over the whole file including frontmatter, so a phrase query is not a phrase ('System R' → 11 notes, none about System R; 'the log' → 23 notes via 'topological'). Title/id search is also plain substring ('dag' → concept-adaptive-optimizers). Snippets repeat per token.
OPERATOR.md: 'open the domain atlas for the full map', but no command or id is given; `inspect` of plausible ids fails.

Workspace membership is one-directional in `related`: a note listed by a workspace (note-naive-bayes-spam-filter in workspace-statlearn-retake) does not show that workspace unless the note itself carries `contexts`.

product_commands_that_produced_candidate: los atlas-context CONCEPT_ID (concept relations, then related)
scenario_record.added_by_own_reading: All garden:, inbox: and stage: targets (listing directories, reading files); project-tessera and workspace-dbsys-exam (found via inspect of workspaces and projects); and cross-domain notes found by reading all note bodies via note-read (e.g. independence assumption C01↔C07, steal/no-force C05↔C15, MLE zero-count C01).

uncertainties: Rankings are my judgement of usefulness for her current goals (Oct exams, Tessera). Items flagged tentative are weak links.
The agent session had a memory index describing LearningOS internals (see run.json deviations). It was not opened during the scenario.
